comments.author: Alex Kim
comments.body: Fix in billing-invoice-render; golden PDF for reverse charge workspace updated.

content.text: Fix in billing-invoice-render; golden PDF for reverse charge workspace updated.

For workspaces with reverse charge VAT enabled, invoice PDFs and the Billing → Invoices detail view show tax amount both as a line-item tax column and again as a separate reverse-charge tax row, effectively doubling the tax display (totals remain correct because one row is a display-only annotation).
Reverse charge invoices should show tax as 0 on lines with a single reverse-charge note, not tax twice. Finance partners flagged PDF exports as non-compliant for their records.

Invoice builder applied the standard tax decorator and the reverse-charge decorator without mutual exclusion. Guarding the standard tax column when tax.regime === reverse_charge removed the duplicate.
